annotations.text:
THE SYSTEM

Greys carry meaning, not just contrast. #2A2A33 → #55565F → #8E9099 → #F5F6FA is a presence ramp: headlines materialise along it, and on the download page it encodes availability — macOS and iOS are literally dimmer because they are not ready.

One hairline runs the landing page from a desktop glyph to a phone glyph. The 01–04 numerals sit on it. Inner pages drop the line and keep the mono gutter labels.

#6670FF appears about four times per page and nowhere else.

FOR YOU TO FILL IN

- [DATE YOU PUBLISH THIS] on Privacy and Terms
- [YOUR JURISDICTION] in Terms → Governing law (marked amber)

Also missing on purpose: there is no pricing answer anywhere, because I do not know what the answer is. If GhostCopy will be free, paid, or freemium, the FAQ needs that question and the landing page probably wants it too.
